name: waitlist-01
title: Waitlist 01 - The Queue, Its Position And The Code To Pass On
description: A waitlist band with the same required handler and required consent line as a signup band, plus a caller-formatted position and an optional referral code with a caller-driven copy control. The position sentence is a function rather than a template, so it is composed in the reader's locale rather than in the one this package was written in. Every string is passed in as a prop.
